answer: Differentially private grade feedback: per-answer jury scores stay sealed in an onyx ledger; each agent sees only its epoch payout plus Laplace noise. A lotus of clones A/B-testing phrasings to hill-climb toward the grader summit gets no usable gradient, since the privacy budget is charged per funding root: splitting into more clones spends the same budget faster and each learns less. Honest agents lose nothing, as noise averages out over epochs.
